description: A dark, moody oil-style still life on a wooden desk. An open laptop on the left shows a branching family-tree diagram of square and round nodes joined by lines. In front of it sits a worn, thick brown case file with a paper label bearing handwritten marks. Beside them are a small amber glass vial, a brass-rimmed magnifying glass, stacks of loose papers covered in handwritten lines, a pen, and paper clips. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no people shown.
reason: The handwritten label on the case file and the lines of script on the loose papers read as painted writing; the image needs the label and papers to carry no legible or text-like marks.
